theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂ with
  | refl a => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | par ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | par ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨a₃, h₃, h₄⟩ := iha ha'
      obtain ⟨b₃, h₅, h₆⟩ := ihb hb'
      exact ⟨_, .par h₃ h₅, .par h₄ h₆⟩
    | red_I =>
      cases I_irreducible _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    | red_K =>
      obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., h⟩
    | red_S =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par h hb) (.par h' hb)⟩
  | red_I a =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    | par hc ha =>
      cases I_irreducible _ hc
      exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
    | red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  | red_K a c =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    | par ha hc =>
      obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, h, .red_K ..⟩
    | red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  | red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    | par hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par h hc) (.par h' hc), .red_S ..⟩
    | red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂ with
  | refl a => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | par ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂ <;> try (refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; constructor <;> assumption)
    case par ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨a₃, h₃, h₄⟩ := iha ha'
      obtain ⟨b₃, h₅, h₆⟩ := ihb hb'
      exact ⟨_, .par h₃ h₅, .par h₄ h₆⟩
    case red_I =>
      cases I_irreducible _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., h⟩
    case red_S =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par h hb) (.par h' hb)⟩
  | red_I a =>
    cases h₂ <;> try (refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; constructor)
    case par hc ha =>
      cases I_irreducible _ hc
      exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  | red_K a c =>
    cases h₂ <;> try (refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; constructor)
    case par ha hc =>
      obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, h, .red_K ..⟩
  | red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂ <;> try (refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; constructor)
    case par hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par h hc) (.par h' hc), .red_S ..⟩

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  have h := h₁
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case' par ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂ <;> try (refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; assumption) <;>
    try exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨_, h₃, h₄⟩ := iha ha' ha
    obtain ⟨_, h₅, h₆⟩ := ihb hb' hb
    exact ⟨_, .par h₃ h₅, .par h₄ h₆⟩
  case par.red_I =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
  case par.red_K =>
    obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., h⟩
  case par.red_S =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par h hb) (.par h' hb)⟩
  case red_I.par hc ha =>
    cases I_irreducible _ hc
    exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par ha hc =>
    obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, h, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par hd hc =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par h hc) (.par h' hc), .red_S ..⟩

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  have h0 := h₁
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case' par ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  all_goals try exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  all_goals try (refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; assumption)
  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨_, h₃, h₄⟩ := iha ha' ha
    obtain ⟨_, h₅, h₆⟩ := ihb hb' hb
    exact ⟨_, .par h₃ h₅, .par h₄ h₆⟩
  case par.red_I =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
  case par.red_K =>
    obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., h⟩
  case par.red_S =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par h hb) (.par h' hb)⟩
  case red_I.par hc ha =>
    cases I_irreducible _ hc
    exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par ha hc =>
    obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, h, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par hd hc =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par h hc) (.par h' hc), .red_S ..⟩

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case' par ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨_, hc⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨_, hd⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hc.1 hd.1, .par hc.2 hd.2⟩
  case' red_I.par ha hb | red_K.par ha hb | red_S.par ha hb => apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
  case par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., h⟩
  case par.red_S | red_S.par =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par h hb) (.par h' hb)⟩
  all_goals
    refine' ⟨_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> constructor <;> assumption

  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  all_goals clear a a₁
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case' par ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨_, hc⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨_, hd⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hc.1 hd.1, .par hc.2 hd.2⟩
  case' red_I.par ha hb | red_K.par ha hb | red_S.par ha hb => apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
  case par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., h⟩
  case par.red_S | red_S.par =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par h hb) (.par h' hb)⟩
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption

  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, ParallelReduction.refl _⟩

  case par.par ha' hb' =>

    exact ⟨_, ParallelReduction.red_S .., ParallelReduction.par (ParallelReduction.par h hb) (ParallelReduction.par h' hb)⟩
  all_goals

    constructor <;> assumption

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl =>
    econstructor
    constructor
    exact h₂
    constructor
  case' par ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨_, hc⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨_, hd⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, hc.1.par hd.1, hc.2.par hd.2⟩
  case' red_I.par | red_K.par | red_S.par =>
    rename_i ha hb
    apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ha
    econstructor
    constructor
    apply ParallelReduction.red_I
    exact hb
  case par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    econstructor
    constructor
    apply ParallelReduction.red_K
    exact h
  case par.red_S | red_S.par =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    econstructor
    constructor
    apply ParallelReduction.red_S
    exact (h.par hb).par (h'.par hb)
  iterate 3 all_goals econstructor
  all_goals assumption
